itineraries.summary: Oneika and her partner Liebling's own 14-day Southern Africa route: 2 days Johannesburg, 2 days Kruger safari, 1 day Blyde River Canyon, 4 days Livingstone (Zambia) and Kasane (Botswana), 5 days Cape Town. Named hotels, safari lodge, restaurants, and prices throughout; she hiked Table Mountain, swam at the edge of Victoria Falls, and did game drives in Sabi Sands and Chobe.
